title: Why Young Adults Are Skipping Marriage
hook: Fewer young adults are getting married at all these days.
closing: If living together already beats marriage for the young, what happens to marriage next?
question: Would you live together before marrying?

segments.say: Among the youngest adults, 9 percent now live with an unmarried partner, more than live with a spouse.
Back in 1968, 82 percent of adults that age lived with a spouse. Today it's fewer than half.
Even older couples are following suit -- cohabiting couples past retirement age have climbed to about 4.2 million since 2000.
